text_block_list.text: Since there was time before training, I went for a stroll around the academy, and—

text_block_list.name: Pony-chans
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaaah!
Fuji-senpaaaaaai♪

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Now then, I guess the lighting looks about right.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to the stage, little pony.
What kind of two-shot do you fancy?

text_block_list.name: Dreaming Pony-chan
text_block_list.text: A-And if possible, please make it exciting... with an arrogant, dominant sort of vibe!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Personally, I'd like to go easy on
the little pony, but—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If it's a dangerous thrill you seek, come to me.
I'll capture a shot that would put even Don Juan to shame.

text_block_list.name: Pony-chans
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaah♪
choice_data_list: ......What are you doing, Fuji?
......I wonder what Fuji is up to.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh♪ Are you curious?
Fuji-san's Trainer-san♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
This is an utterly blessed two-shot photo op
held through Fuji-san's boundless mercy!
choice_data_list: Agnes Digital!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Apparently, it started when a passionate fan asked to see Fuji-san in her Racewear up close, but—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No problem at all, little pony!
While we're at it, why don't we take a photo together?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So you can always look at a photo of us standing
side-by-side with me in my racing silks...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
*Sigh*...
God's fan service is just way too generous...
choice_data_list: So that's why there's a line.
So that explains the line of people.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Her popularity is practically at wall-circle level...
Fuji-san really is amazing~~!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah, if you're gonna line up, you'd better do it soon!
They might close registration if it reaches full capacity!
choice_data_list: Since I'm here, maybe I'll go wait in line.
I'll watch over you just as you are.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Mhfufu♪ Yes, indeed! That's the right choice!
This is gonna make for such an emo picture♪

Afterward—I stood in line, waiting my turn
while thinking back to the day Fuji Kiseki's Racers arrived.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
How's it look, Trainer-san!
Does this racewear suit me?
choice_data_list: Awesome! You look like a stage actor!
Looks great! You look just like a stage actor!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. It makes me really happy to see
that the costume's motif came across clearly.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"My mother, a stage actress...
She stood on countless stages, acting,
singing, and captivating audiences."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The figure I looked up to since childhood still lives in my heart. Though mother and daughter stand in different places—our resolve remains unchanged.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Just like my mother... wearing this outfit,
I want to escort everyone to a dreamlike race someday.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I wanted my racing outfit's design
to be modeled after a stage costume and a tuxedo."
choice_data_list: Let's create the ultimate stage in these racewear!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah, of course!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Now, who is our next little pony—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huh, Trainer??
choice_data_list: I wonder if the surprise worked?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! It wasn't just a success, it was a massive success!
Shall we take a photo, customer?
And so, led by the hand by Fuji Kiseki, we took a photo together on stage.
choice_data_list: Fuji looks like she's shining brighter than ever...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Maybe that's thanks to my racing outfit?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Putting on your racing silks means cloaking yourself
in more than just a set of clothes.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Becoming the ultimate entertainer and crafting an entire world.
—I believe I must wrap myself in that kind of resolve."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I swear it to you and to this racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A stage that captivates all who watch—
I will keep running, to show everyone the supreme race.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"So, if I manage to make my dream come true,
would you let me take another photo with you?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Fuji-senpai, you're so dreamy...!
It's like a marriage proposal...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Fufu... A proposal, huh? That's what they're saying, Trainer. Well, what's your answer?
choice_data_list: O-Of course... it's a yes

text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki's surprises are as bad for the heart as ever.
Bathed in shrieks of delight from the crowd,
I felt that once again.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I see, loving your fave from afar...
Watching over them like that is totally valid, YESSS!

Afterward—while watching over Fuji Kiseki until training began,
I found myself recalling the day her racing Racers arrived.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
How's it look, Trainer-san!
Does this racewear suit me?
choice_data_list: Awesome! You look like a stage actor!
Looks great! You look just like a stage actor!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. It makes me really happy to see
that the costume's motif came across clearly.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"My mother, a stage actress...
She stood on countless stages, acting,
singing, and captivating audiences."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The figure I looked up to since childhood still lives in my heart. Though mother and daughter stand in different places—our resolve remains unchanged.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Just like my mother... wearing this outfit,
I want to escort everyone to a dreamlike race someday.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I wanted my racing outfit's design
to be modeled after a stage costume and a tuxedo."
choice_data_list: Let's create the ultimate stage in these racewear!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah, of course!

While deeply reminiscing about those days—
before long, training time had arrived.
choice_data_list: Fuji, it's time for training!
Fuji, it's time for training.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer?
Is it really that time already...?

text_block_list.name: Pony of Despair
text_block_list.text:
No way~!?
We haven't even taken a selfie together yet……!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, little pony.
I hope there's some way I can make it up to you—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Trainer, would it be alright
if I trained in my racing outfit today?
choice_data_list: It doesn't bother me.
I don't mind at all.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
My little ponies, in lieu of two-shot photos,
I shall run for you today in my racewear.
...Will you watch over me from the VIP seats?

text_block_list.name: Pony-chan of Hope
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes!!
With pleaaasuuurrrreee~♪

text_block_list.name: Pony-chans
text_block_list.text:
Fuji-senpaaaaai!
Do your beeeeeeeest!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, little ponies!
Well then, I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(With these legs, and in this racing outfit.
I'll definitely lead everyone there—
to a glorious future echoing with thunderous applause.)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Watch me, Mother.
This radiance will surely reach your stage, too...!

Fuji Kiseki ran with secret resolve in her heart.
At that moment, the spectators undoubtedly
witnessed a glimpse of a true miracle.
